import pytest
import io
from rich.console import Console
from rich.text import Text
from rich.style import Style
from rich.console import ConsoleOptions
from rich.console import ConsoleDimensions

def test_double_width_char_in_background():
    console = Console(file=io.StringIO(), width=60, height=11)
    console_options = ConsoleOptions(
        size=ConsoleDimensions(60, 11),
        legacy_windows=False,
        min_width=1,
        max_width=60,
        is_terminal=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        max_height=11,
        no_wrap=False,
        markup=None,
        height=None
    )
    text = Text("青春サツバツ論", style=Style(bgcolor="blue"))
    console.print(text, style="on blue", console_options=console_options)
    output = console.file.getvalue()
    assert "青春サツバツ論" in output
